text_elements.text: FOLLOW THE SHAPE LANGUAGE — Different characters use different shapes. Some are round, some are
angular, and some are boxy. Your blockout should reflect the shape language of your chosen concept.
BREAK THE CHARACTER INTO PARTS — Before sculpting, divide the character into major sections like the head,
torso, arms, legs, hands, and feet. This makes the blockout process clearer and more organized.
USE SIMPLE SHAPES — Start with very simple primitive shapes in Blender. Keep the resolution low and avoid
details so you can focus on the overall form.
STRAIGHT VS CURVES — Mixing straight and curved forms makes the character more appealing and dynamic.
This helps avoid stiff or boring shapes.
